title: Attention Is All You Need
authors: A. Vaswani, N. Shazeer, N. Parmar, J. Uszkoreit, L. Jones, A. Gomez, Ł. Kaiser, I. Polosukhin
inst: Google Brain / Google Research / U. Toronto
before: Attention was a component bolted onto recurrent encoder-decoders.
problem: Recurrence forces computation in sequence, which wastes GPUs and limits how far back a model can reliably look.
breakthrough: Remove recurrence entirely. Self-attention lets every position attend to every other in one parallel operation, with multi-head projections and positional encodings to restore order.
why: This is the substrate everything since runs on. Not because attention was new, but because removing recurrence made scale affordable.
next: GPT-1 took the decoder, BERT took the encoder, and the split defined the next five years.
inherits: The architecture itself, essentially unchanged in outline since 2017.
